name: Hanover boathouse
subtitle: Connecticut River at the Hanover boathouse, above Wilder Dam.

course.note: Estimate from the mapped river line upstream of the dock. Not checked on the water.

copy.description: Go, caution or stay off: rowing conditions on the Connecticut River at the Hanover boathouse, NH.
copy.flowStats: Since 2016 the median day is about 5,400 cfs. 14,000 is the top 13% of days, 20,000 the top 5%.
copy.flowHow: Flow is measured at the USGS gauge at West Lebanon, below Wilder Dam, about 4 mi downstream of the dock in a straight line, so it reads what the dam releases. The forecast is from the NWS Northeast River Forecast Center for the same gauge, in 6-hour steps.
copy.credits: Forecast from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/). Alerts from the National Weather Service offices in [Burlington](https://www.weather.gov/btv/) and [Gray](https://www.weather.gov/gyx/), and Lebanon airport observations from the National Weather Service. River flow from USGS gauge [01144500 at West Lebanon](https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/USGS-01144500/). River forecast from the [NWS Northeast River Forecast Center](https://water.noaa.gov/gauges/wlbn3). Air quality from Open-Meteo (Copernicus CAMS), and the model comparison from GFS, ECMWF, GEM and ICON via Open-Meteo.
